advanced-filter-description: Kengaytirilgan filtr quyidagi operatorlarni o'z ichiga olgan qator yozish imkonini beradi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Operatorlar orasidagi ajratuvchi sifatida bo'sh joy ishlatiladi. Siz barcha Maxsus maydonlarni nomlari va qiymatlarini kiritish orqali filtrlashingiz mumkin. Misol uchun: Field1 == Qiymat1. Eslatma: Agar maydonlar yoki qiymatlar bo'sh joydan iborat bo'lsa, ularni bitta tirnoq ichiga kiritishingiz kerak. Misol uchun: '1-maydon' == 'Qiymat 1'. Bitta boshqaruv belgilarini (' \/) o'tkazib yuborish uchun \ dan foydalanishingiz mumkin. Masalan: Field1 == I\'m. Bundan tashqari, siz bir nechta shartlarni birlashtira olasiz. Masalan: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Odatda barcha operatorlar chapdan o'ngga talqin qilinadi. Qavslarni qo'yish orqali tartibni o'zgartirishingiz mumkin. Misol uchun: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Shuningdek, siz regex yordamida matn maydonlarini qidirishingiz mumkin: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-markdown: Markdown vazifalar ro'yxatini joylashtiring (Obsidian Kanban kabi markdown-kanban vositalari foydalanadigan konventsiya): ostida "- [ ]"/"- [x]" elementlari bo'lgan "## Ro'yxat nomi" sarlavhalari. Sarlavhalar ro'yxatlarga, elementlar esa kartochkalarga aylanadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Leo tuzilmasini (.leo fayli) joylashtiring. Yuqori darajadagi tugunlar roʻyxatlarga, ularning bolalari tugun matni tavsif sifatida ishlatiladigan kartalarga, chuqurroq tugunlar esa tekshiruv roʻyxatlariga aylanadi. Belgilangan tugunlar bajarilgan deb import qilinadi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: todo.txt faylini joylashtiring: todo.txt ilovasi va mos ilovalar yozganidek, har bir qatorda bitta vazifa. Tugallangan vazifalar ("x") Bajarildi roʻyxatiga oʻtadi, +project va @context yorliqlarga, (A) ustuvorlik yorligʻiga, due: va t: esa tugash va boshlanish sanalariga aylanadi.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: task export buyrugʻining natijasini joylashtiring: JSON massivi yoki har bir satrda bitta vazifa. Bajarilgan vazifalar Done roʻyxatiga oʻtadi, project va priority yorliqlarga, annotations izohlarga, depends esa toʻsib turgan vazifalarga bogʻliqliklarga aylanadi.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: .boardarchive faylini arxivdan chiqaring va doskaning board.jsonl mazmunini versiya satri bilan yoki usiz joylashtiring. Doska koʻrinishining guruhlash xususiyati roʻyxatlarga, boshqa tanlash xususiyatlari yorliqlarga, matn va belgilash katakchasi bloklari tavsif va tekshirish roʻyxatiga aylanadi, izohlar esa saqlanadi. Rasmlar va ilovalar import qilinmaydi.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.

Jira statuslari roʻyxatlarga va issues kartalarga aylanadi. Ixtiyoriy ravishda qoidalarni import qilish uchun "automationRules" massivini qoʻshing.

r-wrike-workflow-note: A Wrike workflow is a list of statuses, each in the Active, Completed, Deferred or Cancelled group. Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Shunga o'xshash operatorlar birgalikda *YOKI* bo'ladi.  Har qanday shartga mos keladigan kartalar qaytariladi.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` *Bloklangan* yoki *Mavjud* deb nomlangan har qanday roʻyxatdagi kartalarni qaytaradi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Turli operatorlar *VA* birga bo'ladi.  Faqat barcha turli operatorlarga mos keladigan kartalar qaytariladi.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` faqat *qizil* yorlig'i bilan *Mavjud* ro'yxatidagi kartalarni qaytaradi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Kunlarni musbat yoki manfiy butun son sifatida yoki joriy davr uchun `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` yoki `__predicate_year__` yordamida belgilash mumkin.

Compact ni ishga tushirish toʻplam maʼlumotlarini qayta yozish orqali boʻshatilgan joyni qaytaradi. Buni faqat ommaviy fayl koʻchirishlari tugagandan soʻng ishga tushiring.
mongodb-compact-warning: Ogohlantirish: Compact — bu katta maʼlumotlar bazalarida bir necha daqiqa davom etishi mumkin boʻlgan bloklovchi amal. Replika toʻplamlarida barcha ikkilamchilar avval siqiladi (avtomatik ravishda), soʻngra asosiy. Oplog uchun ishlatiladigan bitta tugunli replika toʻplamlarida (odatiy Meteor sozlamasi) faqat asosiy siqiladi.
mongodb-compact-running: Compact ishga tushirilmoqda, bu bir necha daqiqa davom etishi mumkin...
if-you-already-have-an-account: Agar sizda allaqachon hisob qaydnomangiz bo'lsa
invalid-file: Agar fayl nomi noto'g'ri bo'lsa, yuklash yoki nomini o'zgartirish bekor qilinadi.
preview-pdf-not-supported: Qurilmangiz PDF-ni oldindan ko'rishni qo'llab-quvvatlamaydi. Buning oʻrniga yuklab koʻring.
drag-board-to-workspace: __workspaces__ ga belgilash uchun taxtani torting (yon paneldagi ish maydoniga oching)
delete-translation-confirm-popup: Haqiqatan ham ushbu maxsus tarjima qatorini oʻchirib tashlamoqchimisiz? Bekor qilish yo'q.
import-board-zip: Taxta JSON fayllari va biriktirmalari joylashgan taxta nomidagi ichki papkalarni o‘z ichiga olgan .zip faylini qo‘shing
support-info-only-for-logged-in-users: Yordam ma'lumotlari faqat tizimga kirgan foydalanuvchilar uchun.
accessibility-info-not-added-yet: Maxsus imkoniyatlar haqida maʼlumot hali qoʻshilmagan
accounts-lockout-info: Ushbu sozlamalar kirishga urinishlar qo'pol kuch hujumlaridan qanday himoyalanganligini nazorat qiladi.
accounts-lockout-known-users: Ma'lum foydalanuvchilar uchun sozlamalar (to'g'ri foydalanuvchi nomi, noto'g'ri parol)
accounts-lockout-unknown-users: Noma'lum foydalanuvchilar uchun sozlamalar (mavjud bo'lmagan foydalanuvchi nomi)
accounts-lockout-settings-updated: Shafqatsiz kuchdan himoya qilish sozlamalari yangilandi
accounts-lockout-locked-users-info: Foydalanuvchilar tizimga kirish uchun juda ko‘p muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishlar tufayli hozirda bloklangan
accounts-lockout-confirm-unlock: Haqiqatan ham bu foydalanuvchini qulfdan chiqarmoqchimisiz?
accounts-lockout-confirm-unlock-all: Haqiqatan ham barcha qulflangan foydalanuvchilarni qulfdan chiqarmoqchimisiz?
accounts-lockout-click-to-unlock: Ushbu foydalanuvchini qulfdan chiqarish uchun bosing
admin-people-user-inactive: Foydalanuvchi faol emas - faollashtirish uchun bosing

board-backup-failed: Taxta zaxira nusxasini rejalashtirish amalga oshmadi
cron-job-delete-confirm: Haqiqatan ham bu rejalashtirilgan ishni oʻchirib tashlamoqchimisiz?
cron-no-failed-migrations: Qayta urinish uchun muvaffaqiyatsiz migratsiya amalga oshirilmadi
cron-no-paused-migrations: Davom etish uchun pauza qilingan migratsiya yo‘q
filesystem-enabled-description: Fayllarni saqlash uchun mahalliy fayl tizimidan foydalanish
s3-minio-storage-description: S3 mos obyekt xotirasi: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces va boshqalar.
s3-force-path-style-description: MinIO va koʻpchilik AWS boʻlmagan S3 mos serverlar uchun talab qilinadi.
azure-connection-string-description: Ixtiyoriy: hisob nomi va kaliti oʻrniga toʻliq ulanish satridan foydalaning.
database-migration-description: Matnga asoslangan maʼlumotlarni (biriktirmalar va avatarlardan tashqari hamma narsa, ular fayl tizimida qoladi) MongoDB va FerretDB v1 (SQLite) oʻrtasida koʻchiring. Boshqa maʼlumotlar bazasi ishlab turgan va erishilishi mumkin boʻlishi kerak (standart portlar: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL bilan oʻzgartiring). U tugagandan soʻng, MONGO_URL ni boshqa maʼlumotlar bazasiga yoʻnaltiring va WeKan ni qayta ishga tushiring (Snap da: snap set wekan database=ferretdb yoki =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Matn maʼlumotlarini FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ga koʻchirish
database-migration-confirm: Barcha matnga asoslangan toʻplamlar __db__ ga nusxalansinmi? Fayl tizimidagi biriktirmalar va avatarlarga taʼsir qilmaydi. Maqsadli maʼlumotlar bazasi ishlab turgan boʻlishi kerak.
sandstorm-migration-description: WeKan Sandstorm grain ichida ishga tushganda, uning eski MongoDB 3 maʼlumotlar bazasi birinchi ishga tushirishda FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ga koʻchiriladi, biriktirmalar va avatarlar maʼlumotlar bazasidan grain ning files/attachments va files/avatars kataloglariga koʻchiriladi. Bu migratsiya muvaffaqiyatli boʻlganmi va eski xom MongoDB maʼlumotlar bazasi fayllari grain ichida qancha disk joyini egallashda davom etayotganini koʻrsatadi hamda joyni boʻshatish uchun ushbu xom fayllarni oʻchirish imkonini beradi.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Xom MongoDB maʼlumotlar bazasi fayllarini oʻchirish
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Muvaffaqiyatli migratsiyadan soʻng maʼlumotlar FerretDB da va fayl tizimida saqlanadi, shuning uchun grain disk joyini boʻshatish uchun eski xom MongoDB 3 maʼlumotlar bazasi fayllarini oʻchirish mumkin. Buni bekor qilib boʻlmaydi.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Disk joyini boʻshatish uchun xom MongoDB 3 maʼlumotlar bazasi fayllari oʻchirilsinmi? Maʼlumotlar allaqachon FerretDB va fayl tizimiga koʻchirilgan. Buni bekor qilib boʻlmaydi.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Xom MongoDB maʼlumotlar bazasi fayllari oʻchirildi, boʻshatildi
features-desc: Ushbu WeKan taklif qiladigan ixtiyoriy xususiyatlar. Belgilanmagan xususiyat hammaning interfeysidan yashiriladi. Uning maʼlumotlari saqlanadi va ruxsatlar oʻzgarmaydi.
feature-views-table-desc: Taxta saralash mumkin boʻlgan kartalar jadvali sifatida.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Taqvim va bir nechta taxtaning taqvimi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Statistika, biriktirilgan shaxs boʻyicha guruhlash, yoʻl xaritasi, boshqaruv paneli va katta taxta.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Mahsulot ishlari roʻyxati, sprintlar, sprint hisoboti va tezlik.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Qolgan va tugallangan ish, jamlangan oqim, sikl va yetkazish vaqti, bajarilgan ish miqdori, ish yoshi, toʻsiqlar, Monte Karlo va boshqa oqim oʻlchovlari.
feature-approval-required: WeKan yangilanishlari qoʻshgan xususiyatlarni administrator yoqmaguncha oʻchirilgan holda saqlash
feature-preview-admins: Administratorlar avval sinab koʻrish uchun oʻchirilgan xususiyatlarni koʻradilar
feature-pilot-users: Oʻchirilgan xususiyatlarni ham koʻradigan sinov foydalanuvchilari
card-field-visibility-desc: Doskalar koʻrsatishi mumkin boʻlgan Doska sozlamalari / Karta boʻlimidagi maydonlar. Belgisi olib tashlangan maydon barcha doskalarning barcha kartalari, kichik kartalari va Doska sozlamalari / Karta boʻlimida yashiriladi. Karta maʼlumotlari va doska sozlamalari oʻzgarmaydi. Qayta belgilansa, har bir doska avvalgi sozlamalariga muvofiq koʻrsatiladi. Maydonlar tartibi har bir doskaning oʻziga tegishli.
cards-loading-auto: Avtomatik (faqat katta doskalar uchun kechiktirilgan yuklash)
cards-loading-description: WeKan taxta kartalarini avtomatik yuklaydi: katta taxtada (o‘lcham chegarasidan oshganda) faqat hozir ko‘rinadigan kartalar (cheksiz aylantirish) va jonli hisob yuklanadi. Bu tez ishlashni taʼminlaydi hamda kamroq xotira va tarmoq trafigidan foydalanadi. Kichik taxtalarda esa barcha imkoniyatlardan foydalanish uchun barcha kartalar yuklanadi. Hech narsani sozlash shart emas. Operatorlar CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) va CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD muhit o‘zgaruvchilari orqali rejimni belgilashi mumkin.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Kartalarni kerak bo‘lganda yuklash tajribaviy: karta hisoblagichlari va WIP chegaralari aniq, lekin Kalendar/Jadval/Gantt ko‘rinishlari va ko‘p tanlash faqat hozirgacha yuklangan kartalarni aks ettiradi. Buni o‘zgartirgandan so‘ng ochiq taxtalarni qayta yuklang.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Yoqilganda, barcha havolalar (ham [label](url) kabi markdown havolalari, ham xom HTML <a href> teglari) har bir boy matn maydonida (taxta va karta sarlavhalari, tavsiflar, izohlar, tekshirish roʻyxatlari va h.k.) doimo oddiy, bosilmaydigan matn sifatida koʻrsatiladi. Bu chalgʻituvchi bosiladigan havolalarning oldini oladi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan, shuning uchun havolalar bosiladigan boʻlib qoladi.
always-show-code-as-text: Barcha kodni doimo oddiy matn sifatida koʻrsatish
always-show-code-as-text-description: Yoqilganda, boy matn hech qachon markdown yoki HTML sifatida koʻrsatilmaydi: butun manba har bir boy matn maydonida (taxta va karta sarlavhalari, tavsiflar, izohlar, tekshirish roʻyxatlari va h.k.) doimo oddiy matn sifatida koʻrsatiladi. Bu yashirin mazmunni ochib beradi — HTML izohlar (<!-- -->), markdown havolalarining maqsadi, JavaScript va boshqa har qanday kod — shuning uchun barcha kod doimo koʻrinadi, bosilmaydi va ishlamaydi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan, shuning uchun markdown odatdagidek koʻrsatiladi.
disable-all-import-description: Yoqilganda, barcha import xususiyatlari oʻchiriladi: taxtani WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea va Forgejo dan import qilish, shuningdek taxtani klonlash. Import menyusi opsiyalari yashiriladi va server har qanday import soʻrovini rad etadi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
disable-all-export-description: Yoqilganda, barcha eksport xususiyatlari oʻchiriladi: taxtani WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard sifatida yoki NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo ga eksport qilish va bitta biriktirma eksporti. Eksport menyusi opsiyalari yashiriladi va server har qanday eksport soʻrovini rad etadi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
disable-import-avatars-description: Yoqilganda, avatarlar (foydalanuvchi profil rasmlari) hech qachon import qilinmaydi. Bu WeKan JSON importi, Trello importi va tizimga kirishda tashqi identifikatsiya provayderlaridan (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2) avatar sinxronlashni qamrab oladi. Nomlar va boshqa maʼlumotlar hali ham import qilinadi; faqat avatarlar oʻtkazib yuboriladi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
disable-export-avatars-description: Yoqilganda, avatarlar (foydalanuvchi profil rasmlari) taxtani eksport qilishda (WeKan JSON va CSV eksporti) hech qachon kiritilmaydi. Foydalanuvchi nomlari va boshqa maʼlumotlar hali ham eksport qilinadi; faqat avatarlar tashlab yuboriladi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
anonymize-import-users-description: Yoqilganda, WeKan JSON taxtasini import qilish har bir import qilingan foydalanuvchining foydalanuvchi nomi, toʻliq ismi va bosh harflarini hisoblagich oʻrnini bosuvchilar bilan almashtiradi (user1, user2, ...), ularning avatarini olib tashlaydi va import qilingan karta va izoh mazmunidagi @username eslatmalarini (hamda soʻralgan-tomonidan / tayinlangan-tomonidan maydonlarini) qayta yozadi. Manba taxtasidan hech qanday haqiqiy foydalanuvchi shaxsi saqlanmaydi. "user" soʻzi import qiluvchi shaxsning tiliga ergashadi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
anonymize-export-users-description: Yoqilganda, taxtani eksport qilish har bir eksport qilingan foydalanuvchining foydalanuvchi nomi, toʻliq ismi va bosh harflarini hisoblagich oʻrnini bosuvchilar bilan almashtiradi (user1, user2, ...), ularning avatarini olib tashlaydi va karta va izoh mazmunidagi @username eslatmalarini (hamda soʻralgan-tomonidan / tayinlangan-tomonidan maydonlarini) qayta yozadi. Eksport qilingan fayl hech qanday haqiqiy foydalanuvchi shaxsini oʻz ichiga olmaydi. "user" soʻzi eksport qiluvchi shaxsning tiliga ergashadi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ushbu hisobni anonimlashtirmoqchi ekaningizga ishonchingiz komilmi? Bu foydalanuvchi nomi, to‘liq ism va elektron pochta manzilini butunlay anonim o‘rin bosuvchi qiymatlar bilan almashtiradi, avatarni olib tashlaydi va tizimga kirishni o‘chiradi. O‘chirishdan farqli o‘laroq, doskalar, kartalar va sharhlar o‘z tarixini saqlab qoladi va ushbu hisobni, faqat anonimlashtirilgan holda, ko‘rsatishda davom etadi. Bu amalni bekor qilib bo‘lmaydi.
disable-activities-description: Yoqilganda, faoliyat tasmasi yozuvlari hech qachon qayd etilmaydi va hech qayerda koʻrsatilmaydi (taxta yon paneli va karta faoliyat yorligʻi). Kim nima qilgani haqida tarix saqlanmaydi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
disable-notifications-description: Yoqilganda, WeKan hech qachon har qanday faoliyat uchun kuzatuv bildirishnomalarini (ilova ichida, elektron pochta yoki boshqa xizmatlar) yubormaydi. Faoliyatlar hali ham qayd etilishi mumkin (agar yuqorida ham oʻchirilmagan boʻlsa); faqat bildirishnomalar bostiriladi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
disable-watch-description: Yoqilganda, kuzatuv xususiyati oʻchiriladi — foydalanuvchilar bildirishnomalar olish uchun taxtalar, roʻyxatlar yoki kartalarga obuna boʻla olmaydi va kuzatuv darajasini oʻzgartirishga har qanday urinish rad etiladi. Standart holat oʻchirilgan.
backup-description: Biriktirmalar, Avatarlar va/yoki Maʼlumotlarni (biriktirma yoki avatar boʻlmagan barcha matnga asoslangan toʻplamlar) zaxiralang. .zip tanlangan xotiraga bevosita uzatiladi — vaqtinchalik faylsiz — backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip sifatida, YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars va /data ni oʻz ichiga oladi. Bulut xotiralari (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) oʻz xotira yorliqlarida sozlangan maʼlumotlardan foydalanadi.
backup-scope-description: Butun server yoki bitta tashkilot. Tashkilot zaxira nusxasi uning doskalari va ulardagi hamma narsani, jumladan shu doskalarning ilovalarini oʻz ichiga oladi — lekin foydalanuvchi hisoblari va server sozlamalarini oʻz ichiga olmaydi, chunki ular barcha tashkilotlar uchun umumiy. Tashkilot zaxira nusxasini tiklash faqat oʻsha tashkilotga tegishli doskalarga yozadi.
continuous-backup-description: Ma’lumotlar bazasi, biriktirmalar, avatarlar va jurnallardagi har bir o‘zgarishni bir necha soniya ichida katalogga saqlaydi, shunda ma’lumotlarni istalgan paytdagi holatiga tiklash mumkin bo‘ladi. To‘liq arxivlar yaratadigan rejalashtirilgan zaxiralash bilan birga ishlaydi.
continuous-backup-enabled: Ushbu serverda uzluksiz zaxiralashni ishga tushirish
continuous-backup-target: Maqsad katalogi (boshqa diskdagi, tarmoqdagi umumiy resursdagi yoki rclone orqali ulangan xotiradagi mutlaq yo‘l)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: SQLite sahifalari (har bir oraliqda o‘zgargan sahifalar)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Ushbu serverda hech qanday ma’lumotlar bazasi mexanizmi ishlay olmaydi
continuous-backup-key-file: Shifrlash kaliti fayli (maqsad katalogidan tashqaridagi mutlaq yo‘l; 64 ta o‘n oltilik belgi yoki kamida 16 belgili parol iborasi). Nusxasini saqlang: usiz zaxira nusxasini tiklab bo‘lmaydi.
continuous-backup-restore-to: Shu paytdagi holatga tiklash (sana va vaqt)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: SQLite ma’lumotlar bazasi fayli (zaxira nusxa yonida yaratiladi, ishlatilayotgan faylning ustiga hech qachon yozmaydi)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Keyingi qayta ishga tushirishda qayta yaratilgan SQLite ma’lumotlar bazasini o‘rnating (almashtirilgan ma’lumotlar bazasi saqlanadi)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Tanlangan avlod tanlangan paytdagi holatiga tiklansinmi? Tiklash davomida uzluksiz zaxiralash vaqtincha to‘xtatiladi.
backup-restore-confirm: Tanlangan zaxira nusxasi tiklansinmi? Biriktirmalar/avatarlar fayl tizimiga va maʼlumotlar tanlangan rejimga koʻra maʼlumotlar bazasiga yoziladi.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ixtiyoriy: serverdagi xizmat hisobi JSON kalit fayliga yoʻl.
gcs-credentials-description: Ixtiyoriy: xizmat hisobi JSON kalitini joylashtiring. Kalit fayli yoki standart maʼlumotlardan foydalanish uchun boʻsh qoldiring.
gcs-permissions-note: WeKan xizmat hisobiga bucket ga oʻqish/yozish kirishini bering: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → sizning bucket → Permissions → Grant access. "New principals" da xizmat hisobi elektron pochtasini — JSON kalitingizdagi "client_email" qiymatini — joylashtiring, soʻngra "Storage Object Admin" rolini tanlang va Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Joriy qiymatni saqlash uchun boʻsh qoldiring.
gcs-bucket-description: Fayllarni saqlash uchun Cloud Storage bucket nomi.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: boʻsh qoldiring (region endpointidan foydalanadi). S3 mos: MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces konsolingizdagi Endpoint URL.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → sizning bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → sizning bucket nomi (yoki Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → sizning foydalanuvchi → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → 'Application running outside AWS' foydalanish holatini tanlang → Create access key. 'Access key ID' sifatida koʻrsatiladi.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Access key ID bilan bir xil ekran; 'Secret access key' faqat kalit yaratilganda bir marta koʻrsatiladi — uni oʻshanda nusxalang (yoki Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sizning hisob → yuqorida koʻrsatilgan nom (shuningdek Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name ostida).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sizning hisob → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sizning hisob → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sizning hisob → Data storage → Containers → sizning konteyner (yoki + Container yaratish uchun).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → yuqoridagi loyiha tanlagichi → loyihangiz ID si (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → sizning bucket nomi (yoki yaratish uchun Create).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: WeKan serverida yuklab olingan xizmat hisobi JSON kalit fayliga yoʻl (quyida yaratilgan). Bundan foydalaning YOKI quyidagi maydonga JSON ni joylashtiring.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → sizning xizmat hisobi → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (faylni yuklab oladi). Uning mazmunini shu yerga joylashtiring yoki faylni saqlang va uning yoʻlini yuqorida oʻrnating.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Biriktirmani Azure Blob Storage ga koʻchirish
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Biriktirmani Google Cloud Storage ga koʻchirish
gridfs-enabled-description: Fayllarni saqlash uchun MongoDB GridFS dan foydalaning
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Biriktirmalar va avatarlar koʻrinishi uchun ularni CollectionFS dan boshqa har qanday Xotiraga koʻchiring.
s3-access-key-description: Autentifikatsiya uchun AWS S3 kirish kaliti
s3-bucket-description: Fayllarni saqlash uchun S3 paqir nomi
s3-enabled-description: Fayllarni saqlash uchun AWS S3 yoki MiniIO dan foydalaning
s3-endpoint-description: S3 so‘nggi nuqtasi URL manzili (masalan, s3.amazonaws.com yoki minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Autentifikatsiya uchun AWS S3 maxfiy kaliti
s3-ssl-enabled-description: S3 ulanishlari uchun SSL/TLS dan foydalaning
writable-path-description: Fayllarni saqlash uchun asosiy katalog yo'li
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Taxta ma'lumotlari yaxlitligini, jumladan, ro'yxat tartibini, karta o'rnini va suzish yo'li tuzilishini keng qamrovli tekshiruvlar va tuzatishlarni amalga oshiradi.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Ikki nusxadagi bo'sh ro'yxatlarni xavfsiz tarzda o'chiradi. Faqat kartalari bo'lmagan va bir xil nomdagi boshqa ro'yxatlar mavjud bo'lgan ro'yxatlarni olib tashlaydi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: SwimlaneId yoki listId etishmayotgan kartalar va roʻyxatlarni topadi va tiklaydi. Barcha yo'qolgan narsalarni yana ko'rinadigan qilish uchun "Yo'qotilgan kartalar" suzish chizig'ini yaratadi.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Barcha arxivlangan suzish yo'llari, ro'yxatlar va kartalarni tiklaydi. Elementlarni ko'rinadigan qilish uchun etishmayotgan swimlaneId yoki listIdni avtomatik ravishda tuzatadi.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Taxta tarkibidagi etishmayotgan yoki buzilgan ro'yxatlarni aniqlaydi va tuzatadi.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Taxta aʼzolari uchun avatar URL manzillarini toʻgʻri xotiradan foydalanish uchun yangilaydi va buzilgan avatar havolalarini tuzatadi.

migrations-admin-only: Migratsiyani faqat taxta ma'murlari amalga oshirishi mumkin
migrations-description: Ushbu taxta uchun ma'lumotlar yaxlitligini tekshirish va ta'mirlashni amalga oshiring. Har bir migratsiya alohida amalga oshirilishi mumkin.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Bu plata ma'lumotlari yaxlitligini tekshirish va tuzatish uchun keng qamrovli migratsiyani amalga oshiradi. Bu bir necha daqiqa vaqt olishi mumkin. Davom ettirilsinmi?

run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Bu taxta tarkibidagi etishmayotgan yoki buzilgan ro'yxatlarni aniqlaydi va tuzatadi. Davom ettirilsinmi?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Bu taxta aʼzolari uchun toʻgʻri xotiradan foydalanish uchun avatar URL manzillarini yangilaydi. Davom ettirilsinmi?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Bu toʻgʻri xotiradan foydalanish uchun ushbu platadagi barcha fayl biriktirma URL manzillarini yangilaydi. Davom ettirilsinmi?

step-ensure-per-swimlane-lists: Har bir suzish bo'laklari ro'yxatiga ishonch hosil qiling
conversion-info-text: Ushbu konvertatsiya har bir taxtada bir marta amalga oshiriladi va ish faoliyatini yaxshilaydi. Doskadan odatdagidek foydalanishni davom ettirishingiz mumkin.
converting-board-description: Yaxshilangan funksionallik uchun plata tuzilishini konvertatsiya qilish. Bu bir necha daqiqa vaqt olishi mumkin.
migration-batch-size-description: Har bir partiyada ishlov beriladigan biriktirmalar soni (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Protsessordan foydalanish bu foizdan oshib ketganda migratsiyani pauza qilish (10-90)
migration-info-text: Ma'lumotlar bazasini ko'chirish bir marta amalga oshiriladi va tizim ish faoliyatini yaxshilaydi. Brauzerni yopsangiz ham jarayon fonda davom etadi.
migration-warning-text: Iltimos, ko'chirish paytida brauzeringizni yopmang. Jarayon fonda davom etadi, ammo tugallanishi ko'proq vaqt olishi mumkin.
account-locked: Kirish uchun juda koʻp muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishlar tufayli hisob vaqtinchalik bloklangan. Keyinroq qayta urinib ko‘ring.
username-password-required: Foydalanuvchi nomi va parol talab qilinadi
username-too-short: Foydalanuvchi nomi kamida 3 ta belgidan iborat boʻlishi kerak
account-created: Hisob yaratildi! Endi tizimga kirishingiz mumkin.
problems-summary-help: Ko'rib chiqqan muammoli sohalarni belgilang, so'ngra ularning yangi muammolar sonini nolga tushirish uchun Tasdiqlash tugmasini bosing.
problems-in-progress-help: Bu ko'chirish yoki tuzatishlar hozir bajarilmoqda. Ular tugab, protsessor yuki pasaymaguncha kirish sekin bo'lishi yoki "Tizimga kirish kerak" yoxud "Yuklanmoqda, kuting" ko'rsatilishi mumkin.
problems-none-in-progress: Hech qanday ko'chirish yoki tuzatish bajarilmayapti.

import-parts-instruction: Faqat belgilangan qismlar import qilinadi. Eksport qilishda ham xuddi shu tanlov ishlatiladi.

twoFactorCode-invalid: Notoʻgʻri tasdiqlash kodi. Iltimos, qayta urinib koʻring.
subtask-done-no-permission: You cannot change whether this subtask is done
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Bashorat qilish uchun ochiq ish qolmadi - barcha kartalar tayyor.

chart-forecast-projected: Haftasiga __average__ ta karta soʻnggi tezligiga koʻra, ochiq qolgan __remaining__ ta karta __date__ gacha tugallanishi kerak.
list-sync-description: Bu ro'yxatni tashqi kuzatuv tizimidan yangilab turing. Fon vazifasi har 15 daqiqada tekshiradi; darhol tekshirish uchun "Hozir sinxronlash" tugmasidan foydalaning.
drag-to-reorder: Tartibni oʻzgartirish uchun sudrang. Yuqoriga va pastga yoʻnalish tugmalari bir oʻringa siljitadi.
map-view-empty: Bu taxtada hali xarita rasmi yoʻq. Taxta administratori qavat rejasi, hudud xaritasi yoki chizmani yuklashi mumkin, soʻng kartalarni unga joylashtirish mumkin.
map-view-place-hint: Kartani xaritaga sudrang yoki uni tanlab, tegishli joyini bosing.

r-blocks-help: Bitta ishga tushirish hodisasini bitta amalga ulang. Bloklarni asboblar qutisidan sudrab olib keling. Kengaytirilgan sozlamalar uchun shakl muharriridan foydalaning.
r-blocks-unavailable: Qoida maʼlumotlari mavjud emas. Bu qoidani koʻrib chiqish uchun shakl muharriridan foydalaning.
r-blocks-invalid: Aynan bitta ishga tushirish hodisasini bitta amalga ulang. Saqlashdan oldin ulanmagan yoki ortiqcha bloklarni olib tashlang.
r-blocks-conflict: Siz tahrirlayotgan paytda bu qoida oʻzgardi. Saqlashdan oldin saqlangan qoidani qayta yuklang.
r-blocks-permission: Qoidalarni tahrirlash uchun taxta administratori ruxsati kerak.
scrum-releases-select-help: A card can be in several releases. Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) to choose more than one; clear them all to remove the card from every release.
scrum-backlog-help: Ishlarni vazifalar roʻyxatidagi oʻrniga qarab tartiblang. Kartalarni rejalashtirilgan yoki faol sprintga biriktiring.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Yopilgan sprintning saqlangan holati mavjud emas.
scrum-report-help: Hisobotlar sprintning saqlangan holatlaridagi baholarni saqlaydi. Nomaʼlum baholar alohida hisoblanadi; ular nolga teng baholar emas. Ish surʼatini faqat baholash birliklari va qoidalari mos boʻlganda solishtiring.

Doimiy xatolar va qayta urinish chegarasiga yetgan xabarlar koʻrib chiqish uchun saqlanadi. stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
